# Canonical accounting corpus

`chiado-accounting-v1.json` contains whitelisted public facts from the saved
[result-reserves audit](../../../docs/audits/2026-09-16-chiado-result-reserves/README.md).
It is an accounting corpus, not a contiguous RPC backfill source or proof of
independently replayed cross-chain effects. It contains 564 L1 receipts (44 posts,
520 explicitly attributed companions), 350 L2 source receipts, 44 post/member
relationships and 870 source outcome observations. The original chain IDs are
10200 and 6290. Genesis/bootstrap verification is tested separately by the scanner;
this file must never supply a production chain identity implicitly.

The extracted fixture SHA-256 is
`6672ab582f1b10d5d0cd8a223a11d7b569d70b0111b5501d6adaadd285216a4d`.
Embedded provenance includes the original audit/evidence/verifier digests and
membership event positions. The extractor verifies the audit's evidence digest,
canonical block references, transaction/receipt agreement, explicit companion
membership, complete-audit flags and exact captured L1 total before writing.

Reproduce from the local retained audit directory:

```bash
python3 observability/tests/capture-accounting-fixture.py \
  --audit /PATH/TO/candidate/canonical-audit.json \
  --evidence /PATH/TO/candidate/canonical-evidence.json \
  --output observability/tests/fixtures/chiado-accounting-v1.json
```

The L1 total is `221751990942390605` native units:
`215460533874892377` post execution, `1067498228` companion execution,
and `6291456000000000` blob fees for 48 purchased blobs. L2 fees remain separate.
No many-to-many membership join may multiply a receipt charge.

All saved receipts in this particular run succeeded. Reverted-charge, missing
field, invalid quantity and full-width boundary cases are explicitly synthetic
unit regressions; they are not presented as captured Chiado failures. Stored blob
byte reports have `composer_reported_unverified` assurance. They cannot be
promoted to authenticated canonical measurements merely because charges reconcile.
Prepared post hashes can differ from dispatched canonical hashes after a fee
update; provenance preserves both with native generation rather than inferring
identity from transaction order or payer.

Raw signed envelopes, signatures, calldata, private keys, deployment settings and
arbitrary diagnostic messages are excluded. Hashes and public payer/contract
addresses remain diagnostic fields, as allowed by the proposal.

`empty-post-calldata.hex` is a synthetic current-ABI call, generated by
`cargo run --locked -p eez-observer --example posting-fixture`. It carries no
signature or real request. The RPC fixture uses it to distinguish decoded posting
calls from other methods, invalid calldata and noncanonical trailing data. A Rust
test verifies it still matches the protocol encoder.
